mechanism: row-to-core balance / partial row-stripe task partition
hypothesis: When a partial stripe contains multiple tail rows per logical block, contiguous balanced chunks may reduce each block's row-address jumps relative to cyclic tail lanes while preserving per-block work balance.
change: In ProcessWideLowPrecision, keep full-stripe row ownership unchanged and assign the final partial stripe as contiguous balanced row chunks. Each logical block receives floor(tailRows / blockCount) rows plus one for the first tailRows % blockCount owners. Per-block counts remain balanced to at most one row.

scope_check.details: Only logical-block ownership of rows in the incomplete final row stripe changes when tailRows > blockCount. Full stripes, column tiles, GM load/store sizes, rowOffset = sourceRow * rowWidth, output row stride, arithmetic, UB buffers, and reduction topology remain unchanged. No N05 or N08 mechanism is included.

ownership_validation.command: bounded inline Python ownership check: blockCount 1..64, groupWidth 1..8, and rowCount around block/stripe boundaries; compare cyclic and contiguous tail assignments
invariants: Every row is assigned exactly once.
Per-block row counts differ by at most one.
For tailRows <= blockCount, cyclic and contiguous tail row sets are identical.
ownership_validation.scope_note: Static ownership validation only; not runtime correctness, performance, or Core-utilization validation.
